verdict.rationale: Poke exposes a documented API for sending messages programmatically and an official CLI (`npx poke@latest`) for managing MCP servers and recipes, which developers can build against, but there is no evidence of dedicated official SDK packages (e.g., Python/JS client libraries) — probes for OpenAPI/swagger specs and docs.md all returned 404, suggesting no formal SDK artifacts beyond the CLI/API docs. missing for 10: language-specific SDK packages, published OpenAPI/schema spec, independent developer corroboration of SDK usage.
